[[]sky]Sefirah Castle

[[]white]Testing tools mod for better mod playtesting and debugging. Made in response to some utility mods being no longer updated for Mindustry v8.

Current Features:
-Unlocking Tech Trees (Vanilla and Modded)
-Teleporation

Unlocking a tech tree works for all mods, with the "unlock all tech" option.
